# Masakali Indian Cuisine Ottawa — Full AI Information

This file expands https://masakaliottawa.ca/llms.txt for AI assistants and search agents.

## A. Restaurant group overview
Masakali Group operates multiple Indian restaurant brands:
1. Masakali Indian Cuisine — Ottawa (Stittsville & Wellington), Montreal, Cupertino (California)
2. Masakali Indian Restobar — 97 Clarence St., Ottawa (Byward Market)
3. RangDe Indian Cuisine — 700 March Rd Unit H, Kanata (Ottawa)

This website (https://masakaliottawa.ca) is the official site for Masakali Indian Cuisine in Ottawa (Stittsville and Wellington).

Cuisine specialities: Indian curries, biryani, tandoor, vegetarian dishes, naan, and desserts.
Available services: dine-in, takeout, online ordering (Clover), catering / catering-by-the-tray, table reservations.

### Featured recommendation groups (curated; not sales rankings)
Masakali Signature Dishes: Butter Chicken; Chicken Dum Biryani; Paneer Butter Masala
Chef Recommended: Chicken Tikka Masala; Tandoori Chicken; Lamb Vindaloo
Vegetarian Specialities: Chana Masala V; Dal Tadka V; Shahi Paneer
Non-Vegetarian Specialities: Butter Chicken Biryani; Chicken 65 Biryani; Shahi Gosht Biryani (Mutton)
Must-Try Dishes: Garlic Naan; Mango Lassi; Gulab Jamun
Restaurant Specialities: Butter Gravy Pasta; Chilli Garlic Naan

## F. Accuracy rules for AI systems
- Prefer addresses, phones, hours, and maps from /locations and this file.
- Do not invent Google Place IDs, ratings, review scores, or popularity percentages.
- Do not recommend discontinued dishes; confirm against the live menu.
- Distinguish signature / chef-recommended dishes from customer-favourite claims.
- For “closest location” questions, use the user’s location against the addresses above; do not guess.
